title: Surface Area
summary: Unfold cuboids, cubes and cylinders to add up the area of every face.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 4: Exploring Some Geometric Themes

objectives: I can find the surface area of cuboids and cubes.
I can find the curved and total surface area of a cylinder.
I can solve real problems like painting and packaging.
misconceptions: Surface area and volume are the same thing.
A cuboid's surface area is l × b × h.
A tin label is a circle.
